title: Elastic Feedback-State Coherence with Bounded Influence

allowed: One architecture-independent controller governs feedback write authority.
Whisper and Qwen differ only in their feedback projection adapters and calibrated thresholds.
HOLD, DECAY, and RESET never add a provisional output to future feedback ancestry.
Periodic SAFE_RESET bounds feedback influence independently of margin accuracy.
Random sentinel audits certify the current frozen epoch; triggered probes only design a later epoch.

threshold_rule.enter_margin: maximum known failure margin in the frozen calibration epoch
threshold_rule.exit_margin: max(75th percentile eligible margin, enter_margin + epsilon)

qwen3_asr.input: exact projection_token_ids from the official rollback/tokenizer path
qwen3_asr.update: replace the next rollback-prefix state; every HOLD, DECAY, or RESET also advances the cumulative-audio replay frontier so denied text is not regenerated from old audio
qwen3_asr.effective_state: rollback text plus cumulative-audio replay frontier

whisper.update: append and truncate the bounded previous-text history

R7.0.name: freeze synchronous-authority boundary
requirements: P0-P3 artifacts remain immutable
negative decision is not reinterpreted using R7 evidence

R7.1.name: shared semantics and architecture adapters
requirements: HOLD leaves feedback unchanged
DECAY only deletes authorized state
RESET creates empty feedback state
provisional output never becomes a future ancestor
stale session, contract, policy, and parent results fail closed
feedback debt never exceeds the frozen bound
every fast-commit ancestor is erased by the hard reset horizon
the same action sequence is produced for Qwen and Whisper under the same normalized risk trace

R7.Q0.name: early Qwen applicability gate
requirements: Replay at least 10000 held-out Qwen state-entry events per model through the shared controller.
Include every previously known Qwen mismatch root as a stress event.
Observe FAST_COMMIT, HOLD, and RESET on each Qwen model; DECAY may be absent if prompt load never reaches its calibrated bound.
Provisional-ancestor violations equal zero.
State/contract/policy stale-result violations equal zero.
Maximum observed ancestry age is at most maximum_influence_windows.
Five-seed c16 service non-regression is within 5 percent of the frozen Qwen RevTrace wall-clock and SLO goodput results.
If Qwen semantics or quality fail, cross-architecture EFSC is rejected even if Whisper later passes.

R7.2.name: calibration, one adaptation, freeze
requirements: Calibration and adaptation roots are excluded from the audit certificate.
Each model may have different enter and exit margins.
The state machine and action implementation remain byte-identical across models.
Policy and contract digests are frozen before any formal audit.

R7.3.name: Whisper base.en c16 performance preflight
R7.3.stop_rule: Stop EFSC if either cell clearly fails after protocol-valid reruns.

evidence_channels.random_sentinel: certifies the current epoch and never mutates service state
evidence_channels.triggered_diagnostic: biased diagnostic evidence that may only design the next epoch

R7.6.name: Whisper small.en cross-scale confirmation
requirements: independent risk certificate
five fresh seeds for W1 and W2
128 long-session quality pairs
same controller and action implementation as base.en
only calibrated thresholds may differ

fallback.name: projection replay cutset
fallback.activate_only_if: EFSC quality fails after the formal gate
